concepts: phase III randomized controlled trial fecal microbiota transplantation immune checkpoint inhibitor solid tumor results
gap.question: Are there any completed and published Phase III randomized controlled trials of microbiome interventions (FMT, probiotics) in ICI-treated solid tumour patients?
success_criteria: Confirmation of completion status and primary outcome data (PFS/OS) for specific Phase III trials (e.g., CanBiome2, TACITO).
gap.user_scope: How does the gut microbiome modulate the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors in solid tumours, and what mechanisms mediate that effect?
